summary: Ascendis Pharma A/S disclosed in a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer equivalent of an 8-K) its agreement to sell a Rare Pediatric Disease Priority Review Voucher (PRV) for $187.5 million in cash. The PRV was granted upon FDA accelerated approval of YUVIWEL. This is a capital-generating transaction that provides immediate non-dilutive cash, strengthening the company's balance sheet. The board approved the sale; no advisor is named. The closing is implied but not specified; the cash will support operations and R&D. Watch for any regulatory or counterparty risk affecting proceeds timing.
